newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London fall on property price worries.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London fall on property price worries.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks fell in London on Tuesday as investor concern about possible government curbs on property prices in Hong Kong and selling of shares in HSBC Holdings weighed on sentiment, dealers said.
Dealers said market-makers marked share prices down after cautious trading in Hong Kong spilled over into London.
The Hang Seng index eased 87.45 points to close 14,307.15, amid worries over the possible imposition of property price curbs expected to be announced after Hong Kong reverts to China on July 1.
The Hang Seng London Reference index reflected the nervous mood as it dropped 119.53 points to finish at 14,187.62.
In the propety sector, Henderson Land eased 20 cents to HK$64.30 and Sun Hung Kai Properties declined 40 cents to HK$ 86.60.
Losses were exacerbated by selling of shares in HSBC following a weak performance in London by shares in UK banks. HSBC shares fell HK$3.80 to HK$225.20.
